annotations.title: Daily AI Raises from SEC Form D, Scored for Distribution Moat

description: Mode VC's daily read on AI private markets: every new SEC Form D notice from one filing day that public evidence shows is an AI company, scored 1 to 5 with Mode VC's Distribution Moat rubric, with the evidence and reasoning behind each score (the company's own pricing, integrations, customers, docs and product pages when it links them), the status of each distribution lever, atlas partners named in the filing (confirmed and possible kept apart) and the firm's Form ADV private fund assets where that match is confirmed. Filings the evidence cannot settle are listed as unclear, not guessed. A Form D is a self-reported notice, not a closed round. Leave date empty for the latest day.

date.description: Form D filing date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: latest day available.

include_unclear.description: Also list filings the evidence could not settle. Default true.

min_moat_score.description: Only raises scoring at least this. Default 1 (all).

name: get_daily_ai_raises
title: Daily AI Raises from SEC Form D, Scored for Distribution Moat
